goal: Turn large public corpora into compact reusable structured features while minimizing user interaction, machine-local work, paid compute, and unrecoverable batch loss.

execution_planes.private_local_state: OSR Watcher on Mac only when genuinely required

scheduler_policy.override_rule: A large batch may use more than 12 hosted runners only when the user explicitly prioritizes that batch over concurrent OSR work.
scheduler_policy.reason: A 20-way Gonggong-Gun matrix was observed occupying all 20 hosted-runner slots and queueing Feature Store plus other OSR workflows.

recovery_policy.write_semantics: Parquet and JSON checkpoints are written atomically before completion is advertised
recovery_policy.durable_checkpoint_store: GitHub Release assets for compact Feature Store partitions
recovery_policy.resume_rule: On every run, read durable completion markers and execute only missing or invalid partitions
recovery_policy.automatic_recovery: One recovery wave recomputes only incomplete partitions
recovery_policy.final_acceptance: PASS requires exact partition count, exact 1788-shard inventory coverage, schema identity match, source-inventory identity match, zero failed shards, and no duplicate/missing shard identities
recovery_policy.partial_rule: Any incomplete coverage is PARTIAL/FAILED; never promote partial output to PASS
recovery_policy.asset_integrity_next: Completion validation should also bind summary to durable data asset name/size/hash so a marker cannot survive without its data payload.

primary_product.output: versioned sparse Feature Store in Parquet + compact feature catalog
layers: F0 shard structural features over the complete corpus
F2 selective deep entity/event extraction over high-signal rows only

supported_now.output: Parquet feature-store partitions + compact JSON feature catalog
edge/node candidate tables for downstream review

examples: q-gram locator for repeated query families

not_default.reason: Quickwit/Tantivy pilot expanded sampled text by 6.1566x; 508GB and the research workload do not justify Elasticsearch/Quickwit deployment overhead
Operational complexity and persistent storage are unnecessary at this corpus scale and workload shape; search is auxiliary, not the primary product
3-gram pilot expanded sampled text by 1.8198x; useful only for repeated high-value query families
Deep NER/LLM inference over every byte is economically wasteful; deep extraction is routed only to high-signal rows
Mac+rclone measured only 1.7-2.4 MiB/s and adds user-machine dependency
Raw data remains upstream; runners hydrate ephemeral shards and persist only compact derivatives
Observed to starve all queued OSR workflows; large jobs default to 12-way fair-share

current_priority: allow the currently running 20-way Gonggong scan to finish without destroying already-computed work
start feature-store-v1-resilient-001 when hosted-runner slots free
persist 128 durable partition checkpoints and automatically recover missing partitions
measure signal-row density and durable Feature Store size
build selective F2 entity/event extraction over F1 high-signal rows
economic_rule: Prefer feature backfill and selective deep extraction over persistent universal search infrastructure; build an index only when repeated lookup savings exceed storage and operational cost.
evidence_rule: Every derived feature must retain source corpus, shard, row or equivalent locator, and hash/provenance sufficient for exact source recheck.
